reply.instructions: Should one of the bots listed in [bots] answer this message in chat? Say yes when a player standing there would answer: the message greets, thanks, asks, compliments, teases or insults these bots, names one of them, or invites an answer. Say no when it is aimed at someone else, is a trade or group post, spam, or chatter that needs no answer.

criteria.true: one bot should answer in chat

line.instructions: Which line should the answering bot say? Each option starts with its kind in brackets. {name} is the player's name and {me}, {class}, {spec}, {level}, {zone} are the bot's own details; they are filled in afterwards. The lines are in the players' language, mostly French. Pick silent when no line fits the message.
